setup_guide.introduction: I'll organize documents into draft findings, timelines and counterevidence for legal review. Try the public synthetic EMC-2 sample from GitHub, or choose an authorized folder and tell me which question the review should answer. At handoff, I'll explain the evidence, limits and next decision for counsel.

sample.title: EMC-2 investigation sample
sample.description: Download the pinned public EMC-2 repository from GitHub and analyze its synthetic documents.
sample.expected_output: After the sample investigation completes, a local interactive draft with cited findings, counterevidence, relationship paths and an audit for human review.

values.inputs.payload.goal: Investigate financially relevant events and competing explanations in the synthetic EMC-2 materials. Cite the evidence and state limitations.

real.introduction: Choose your authorized document folder, then name the question this review should help answer. Optional counsel intake and previous decisions are available in Configure. I'll return a partial draft with evidence, competing explanations and one next review question.

fields.label: Legal documents folder
fields.description: Choose the folder you are authorized to review. Use Start from sample data for the public synthetic EMC-2 case.

fields.label: What question should this review help you answer?
fields.description: Name the disputed event or decision to support. Include a date range or transaction reference if useful. I will test competing explanations; your question is review direction, not evidence.

fields.label: Counsel matter intake
fields.description: Optional matter.json for questions, exclusions and source-cited transaction records. Add in Configure before starting when needed; Chat cannot clear restricted sources.

fields.label: Review scope
fields.description: First pass returns a bounded, partial review; standard permits deeper relationship extraction and more investigation rounds.

fields.label: Output folder
fields.description: An additional copy of the review draft and audit files is saved here.

fields.label: Previous review decisions
fields.description: Optional review-decisions.json from this matter. Add in Configure when available. Changed evidence requires a fresh wording review.

fields.label: Saved explanation preferences
fields.description: Managed in Memory. Changes Chat wording only; domain work and approvals keep their existing controls.

starter_questions: Can I try the public synthetic EMC-2 case?
Which documents and review scope do you need?
What supports this finding, and what contradicts it?

web_ui.description: Optional offline source-linked investigation, published after citation verification.

registration.writes: static-html web_ui.json handle in the run output
